name: Fjord Longhouse — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Cedar longhouse with a broad dark-slate steep roof, deep front gable/porch, warm amber glazing, curved root/animal-like ridge carvings and carved timber posts. A long rectangular building in iso, not a castle tower complex. Hidden layout inference: Place a sheltered entrance apron facing the fjord path, one long quiet hall beyond, and a side porch overlooking water/trees. An exterior loop returns visitors without requiring unplayed kitchen/service rooms. A rear covered lookout is a proposed extension, not clearly shown. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B16-DETAIL-001 — Fjord Longhouse — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need long wall/post bay, gable/roof ridge end, porch threshold and carved curved ridge supports. Source already contains cedar grain, amber glazing and Nordic scrolls; do not reuse B12 crown signs or Gothic capitals indiscriminately. Conifers/heather/moss; fox/hare/woodland birds proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
